CustomField.formula:
IF (ISBLANK(Angry_To__c), "",
IF(HOUR(Angry_To__c) <= 12, TEXT(HOUR(Angry_To__c)), TEXT(HOUR(Angry_To__c)-12)) & ":" &
IF (MINUTE(Angry_To__c) < 10, "0" + TEXT(MINUTE(Angry_To__c)), TEXT(MINUTE(Angry_To__c))) &
IF (HOUR(Angry_To__c) < 12, " AM", " PM"))
CustomField.label: Angry to Formula
